title: Locate, Judge, Read: Role-Specialized Tool Agents over a Knowledge-Point Index for Open-Domain Multimodal Document QA
abstract: arXiv:2610.13128v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Question answering over large heterogeneous document collections requires first finding the right passages and then reading them, yet current retrieval-augmented agents give one model both kinds of tools and let it schedule itself. We present KnowForge, a pipeline separated by job: a hybrid-retrieval knowledge-point index; a Locator agent that can only search; a code-scheduled bridge judge that forces the missing second hop; a typed, size-bounded evidence pool that merges every search's ranking; a Deep Reader agent that can only read text, images and tables; and a synthesizer with a format checker. With a self-hosted Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (3B active), KnowForge reaches F1 47.5 on the full open-domain M3DocVQA (2,441 questions, 3,368 PDFs), +11.0 over the published M3DocRAG system and +7.1 over one-shot retrieve-and-answer on the same index and model, and 53.5 with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. On MultiHop-RAG it reaches 73.5 accuracy, above the strongest

translated_title: 定位、判断、阅读：基于知识点索引的角色专门化工具代理用于开放域多模态文档问答
translated_abstract: 对大型异构文档集合进行问答需要先找到正确的段落再进行阅读，然而当前的检索增强代理将两类工具都交给同一个模型并让其自行调度。我们提出了KnowForge，一个按职能分离的流水线：一个混合检索的知识点索引；一个只能执行搜索的定位器代理；一个由代码调度的桥接判断器，强制执行缺失的第二跳检索；一个类型化、大小受限的证据池，用于合并每次搜索的排序结果；一个只能阅读文本、图像和表格的深度阅读器代理；以及一个带有格式检查器的综合器。通过自托管的Qwen3.6-35B-A3B（激活参数3B），KnowForge在完整的开放域M3DocVQA（2,441个问题、3,368个PDF）上达到F1 47.5，比已发布的M3DocRAG系统高出11.0，比在同一索引和模型上进行一次性检索回答高出7.1；使用DeepSeek-V4-Flash时达到53.5。在MultiHop-RAG上达到73.5的准确率，高于最强（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出按职能分离的KnowForge流水线，通过知识点索引、仅能搜索的定位器、强制第二跳检索的桥接判断器和仅能阅读的深度阅读器等角色专门化工具代理，在开放域多模态文档问答上显著超越了现有检索增强方法。
en_tdlr: KnowForge introduces a job-separated pipeline of role-specialized tool agents—a search-only Locator, a code-scheduled bridge judge forcing the second retrieval hop, and a read-only Deep Reader over a knowledge-point index—significantly outperforming existing retrieval-augmented agents on open-domain multimodal document QA.
